meaning: Invisible string that brings the internet to your phone without using your mobile pack. At home, use your own Wi-Fi.
A small tool inside your phone. WhatsApp is an app for talking. Each app is like one shop in a big market.
Making an app new again, like stitching a torn pocket. Updates fix mistakes and keep bad people out.
A photo of what is on your screen right now. Like clicking a photo of your phone's face.
A secret number the bank sends only to you. It is like a one-time key. Never tell it to anyone.
Internet that comes from your SIM card pack. Videos eat it fast. Wi-Fi does not eat your pack.
A small knock on your phone's door. It tells you someone sent a message or something happened.
